The '''Aegis-7 battle droid''' was an advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model. [[Rokko]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] owned one. Instead of legs, the Aegis-7 featured [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] plates, which gave the droid greater maneuverability and more speed.
